verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing lists a native Automations product and describes agents that run in the background: a Super Agent that "works 24/7" and takes delegated tasks, user-built custom agents, and a Triage Agent that prioritizes bugs. This is first-party evidence of autonomous background work, but every item is a one-line headline with no documentation of how automations are configured, triggered, or run. Missing for 10: documentation of automation setup (triggers, conditions, actions), details on how agents run unattended on a schedule or on events, and independent or hands-on confirmation that they run reliably.
